summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary  I traced the full watchlist chain before writing this plan (read-only, no edits made):  - **Client** (`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`) — loads via `api.get("/watchlist")`, saves via `api.post`/`delete` to `/watchlist/:id/items`. No localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in this file. - **API client** (`client/src/lib/api.ts`) — every request uses `credentials: "include"`, so cookies are sent consistently, same as portfolio. - **Auth** (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`) — login/signup issue a session tied to a stable, persistent `users.id`; cookie
